about: Tags as stored on a wine or a discovery, shared by CaveKit (DiscoveryTests.swift) and the Kotlin core (DiscoveryTest.kt): trimmed of Unicode White_Space (U+0009-000D, 0020, 0085, 00A0, 1680, 2000-200A, 2028, 2029, 202F, 205F, 3000) and nothing else, without empty or duplicate tags (ignoring case), in the order given.
